attributes.body:
OneBill Software launches CPQ360.ai, an ai-first CPQ built to work with any billing stack.

Aug 06, 2026, 11:00 ET

SANTA CLARA, Calif., Aug. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ - OneBill Software today announced the launch of CPQ360.ai, an AI-first configure-price-quote product built to run on top of any billing platform to complete the quote-to-revenue lifecycle. CPQ360.ai governs every quote, rep-built or AI agent-built, under the same pricing rules, margin guardrails, and approval logic, then hands off clean, billing-ready terms through native connectors - live today for Stripe, with additional platforms in active development.

CPQ360.ai is built for the industries where quoting complexity is highest - telecom, hi-tech, manufacturing, and medical devices; where complex bundles, configurable pricing, and multi-party approvals make manual quoting unworkable.

Unlike CPQ tools that bolt AI onto an existing UI, CPQ360.ai is API-first, with REST APIs, webhooks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) access built in from day one. It's billing-platform agnostic by design, so the quote-to-revenue lifecycle completes on whatever CRM, contract, and billing stack a team already runs - Salesforce or HubSpot for CRM, any eSign tool, and any billing platform - without requiring teams to replace what's already working.

"We set out to build an agentic-first CPQ that drops into any RevOps stack, on any billing platform," said JK Chelladurai, Founder and CEO of OneBill Software. "Our team spent years running quote-to-revenue at scale inside OneBill. CPQ360.ai is built on that experience, so an AI agent and a human rep are held to the exact same rules, on any billing platform."

CPQ360.ai is available now at www.cpq360.ai, where teams can book a personalized demo or start a free trial.

About CPQ360.ai

CPQ360.ai is a configure-price-quote product built for agentic execution on an API-first foundation, completing the quote-to-revenue lifecycle on whatever CRM, contract, and billing systems are already in place. CPQ360.ai is a OneBill Software company. Learn more at www.cpq360.ai

Media Contact: Ravi Condamoor | marketing@cpq360.ai | +1 (408) 505 - 4212

SOURCE OneBill Software

attributes.body:
OneBill unifies the entire revenue lifecycle with launch of Field Service Management and Professional Services Automation.

Published at April 14th 2026, 9:00 AM EDT via Get News

New FSM and PSA capabilities close the revenue loop from first quote to long-term customer success

Santa Clara - April 14, 2026 - OneBill, the leading Quote-to-Cash-to-Care (Q2C2C) platform for subscription and usage-based businesses, today announced the launch of Field Service Management (FSM) and Professional Services Automation (PSA) bringing its Care layer to full capability and closing the loop on the full customer revenue lifecycle.

Closing the Post-Sale Revenue Gap

Businesses have long managed the front end of the revenue cycle quoting, billing, revenue recognition while losing margin on the back end to disconnected service delivery tools, manual handoffs, and a lack of visibility between what was billed and what was delivered. OneBill's Q2C2C framework was built to eliminate this gap giving businesses a single platform to quote, bill, deliver, and support without stitching together a fragmented toolstack.

What's Now Live

* Field Service Management AI-powered dispatch and intelligent scheduling recommend optimal technician assignments in real time, while automated work order creation from billing and provisioning events ensures field operations stay in sync with what was sold and billed. Job completion tracking closes the loop, no manual re-entry, no reconciliation lag.
* Professional Services Automation Project management, resource allocation, time and expense tracking, and project profitability all connected to billing. Every billable hour is captured and invoiced accurately, eliminating one of the most persistent sources of revenue leakage in services businesses.

OneBill is currently onboarding select customers onto FSM and PSA. Contact us to schedule a platform demo.

"From the beginning, OneBill was built on a simple conviction: that businesses shouldn't have to choose between a great billing platform and great service operations. With FSM and PSA completing our Care layer, we've closed the loop. Our customers can now manage the entire revenue lifecycle from the first quote to the last service job on a single platform, with a single source of truth. That's not just operational efficiency. That's revenue you stop losing." - JK Chelladurai, CEO, OneBill

About OneBill

OneBill is a unified Quote-to-Cash-to-Care platform serving subscription, usage-based, and services-driven businesses across telecom, cloud, utilities, logistics, and digital service providers. From CPQ and billing to revenue recognition, channel management, and customer care, OneBill powers the entire revenue lifecycle on a single platform.

OneBill launches RevAssure360: ai-powered revenue assurance platform to detect, prevent, and predict revenue leakage.

News provided by.

SANTA CLARA, Calif., Sept. 23, 2025 /PRNewswire/ - OneBill Software Inc., a leading cloud-based billing and monetization platform, today announced the launch of RevAssure360, an AI-powered revenue command center designed to help businesses detect, prevent, and predict revenue leakage in real time, while providing future-looking insights for sustainable growth.

In today's fast-paced digital economy, unnoticed errors in billing, invoicing, order fulfillment, and renewals often go undetected, silently eroding profits. In fact, it has been reported that some businesses are losing between 3% and 8% in total revenue, due to lack of robust internal auditing (Source: PWC).

Traditional audits only uncover issues after the damage is done. Whereas RevAssure360 changes that by offering proactive, predictive, and consultative revenue assurance - all in one unified platform.

"Our vision has always been to unify revenue operations - helping businesses not just recover lost revenue, but also anticipate risks, forecast growth, and make strategic decisions with confidence," said JK Chelladurai, Founder and CEO of OneBill.

Key Features of RevAssure360

Real-Time Failure Detection: Instantly surfaces issues in orders, invoices, renewals, and integrations.

AI-Driven Root-Cause Analysis: Identifies recurring failure types such as renewal issues, scheduled operation failures, and missed usage and subscription charges.

Granular Dashboards: Transaction-level insights reveal both actual and estimated revenue at risk.

Guided Remediation & Collaboration: Role-based alerts and integrated playbooks align Finance, Support, Product, and IT teams for rapid action.

Predictive Intelligence: AI models anticipate future risks, project revenue forecasts, and provide actionable recommendations for sustainable growth.

Prevent and recover revenue loss before it impacts the P&L.

Accelerate cash collection and reduce DSO.

Improve cross-functional alignment around revenue goals.

Strengthen customer trust through proactive communication.

Enable long-term growth by moving from reactive to predictive revenue management.

Already, customers leveraging RevAssure360 have reduced month-end leakage by over 80%, achieving measurable improvements in cash flow and customer retention.

This launch reinforces OneBill's leadership in empowering organizations to move beyond traditional audits and toward future-ready revenue operations.

Want to see RevAssure360 in action? Contact OneBill today to schedule a demo.

About OneBill
OneBill empowers businesses to streamline billing and revenue management, automate order fulfillment, accelerate subscription growth, and reduce customer churn through one unified platform. With nine seamlessly integrated products, OneBill delivers a 360-degree solution for all revenue operations.

OneBill launches RevRec360(TM) to transform revenue recognition and compliance operations.

News provided by.

SANTA CLARA, Calif., Aug. 6, 2025 /PRNewswire/ - OneBill, a leading cloud-based billing and monetization platform, has announced the launch of RevRec360(TM), a next-generation revenue recognition and compliance solution. Designed for finance teams navigating complex revenue models, RevRec360(TM) delivers precision, automation, and audit-ready transparency in a single platform.

Traditional revenue recognition processes often involve manual steps, siloed systems, and compliance risks. RevRec360(TM) eliminates these challenges by providing a powerful framework that aligns with global standards like ASC 606 and IFRS 15. OneBill follows the industry-standard five-step revenue recognition model to ensure accuracy and consistency at every stage:

Identify performance obligations within each contract

"RevRec360(TM) is a natural extension of our platform's mission - to help businesses eliminate operational inefficiencies and maintain complete control over their revenue lifecycle," said JK Chelladurai, Founder and CEO of OneBill. "With this launch, we are bringing the same flexibility and automation to revenue recognition that our customers have come to rely on for billing and monetization."

Built-in Compliance: Align with ASC 606 and IFRS 15 to ensure accurate revenue recognition and simplified audit readiness.

Automated Recognition: Implement the complete five-step model with confidence and control.

Audit-Ready Transparency: Capture, document, and verify revenue events with detailed reports. Streamline reconciliation and financial reporting through seamless integration with accounting and ERP systems.

Proven Scalability: Reliably handle high transaction volumes while maintaining accuracy across complex revenue scenarios.

Flexible Integrations: Connect with billing, CRM, ERP, accounting, and payment systems through open APIs. Enable real-time synchronization of contract, billing, payment, and financial data for end-to-end revenue accuracy.

To learn more about RevRec360(TM), visit: https://www.onebillsoftware.com/revrec360/

PRESS RELEASE — CHANNEL PARTNERS CONFERENCE & EXPO, LAS VEGAS, April 11 — OneBill Software (Booth 2250), a cloud-based billing and revenue management platform provider, launches a new enhancement to their Channel Management solution, which enables companies not only to execute real time multi-party settlement and commissions, but also SPIFF incentive payments. SPIFF incentive schemes are often challenging to manage, as businesses need to pay this over and above an agent commission rate and not necessarily within the same time periods. However, with the OneBill platform, configuring unique rules for SPIFF payments to be paid upon settlement, is easily configurable through the Channel Partner Module. attributes.body: JK Chelladurai, Founder & CEO of OneBill, interviewed by the CEOWORLD Magazine on how he channels his 32 years of IT experience and 26+ years of experience in building BSS/OSS solutions for the telecommunications industry to transform the consumption economy with OneBill. JK: I started working for Portal Software back in 1996 which provided an on-premise solution, where customers had to invest millions of dollars to obtain a licence and then spend a few million more dollars to receive the actual solution. Therefore only very large companies had the resources to afford that kind of OSS/BSS solution. This created a significant barrier to other smaller service providers accessing a solution. So, OneBill Software Inc. saw an opportunity to provide a flexible cloud-based, OSS/BSS solution for businesses of all sizes with varying needs. At the time OneBill Software Inc. launched OneBill, there were other billing solutions out there offering cloud-based platforms, but they were yet to infiltrate industries such as SaaS.
